title: Long Term Ecological Observatories (LTEO)
definition: A systematic, multi-decadal scientific program designed to monitor, document, and analyze long-term changes in India's diverse ecosystems to understand the impacts of climate change and anthropogenic pressures.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for Environment (GS-III) and Climate Change modules; tests the ability to link ecological data with policy-making, biodiversity conservation, and sustainable development goals.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Long Term Ecological Observatories.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
